reviews.text: After looking at a few different pool service companies, we chose Blue Science Pools for our backyard project. Mike answered all our questions and gave us helpful suggestions without ever making us feel rushed or pressured. Throughout the whole process, Ardie, our project manager, kept us in the loop and made sure everything was running smoothly. Blake even came out on a holiday to make sure our pool was ready for a family visit, which meant a lot to us, and he also made time to walk us through how to take care of our pool so it fit with our busy schedules. When it was time for the acid wash on our pool deck, Ardie took his time and made sure everything looked great. We were also impressed with how well we were kept informed about the work schedule, thanks to the efficient and friendly team. Finally, one of the staff helped set up our pool controls so we could manage everything from our phones, which is super convenient. Overall, we’re really happy with our pool and the service we received. Everything was handled professionally from start to finish, and we highly recommend them for anyone looking for pool service in Texas.
reviews.author: Delilah Freeman

reviews.text: The team did an excellent job with our pool cleaning and maintenance. Mike and Austin were both easy to work with and coordinated well with the other workers on site, since our pool was being installed while the house was still under construction. They kept me updated throughout the whole process, made sure everything was cleaned up after finishing each day, and always followed through on what they promised. We’re really happy with how clean and sparkling our pool looks, and it works perfectly. We couldn’t be happier with the service we received.
reviews.author: Lily Mccarty

reviews.text: We recently had our pool in Denton cleaned, resurfaced, and retiled, plus the deck drain was upgraded and the concrete deck got a fresh stamped overlay. We are extremely happy with how everything turned out! Austin explained all our pool cleaning and upgrade options, walking us through each step of the process so we knew exactly what to expect. The work started right on schedule and Austin was always professional, honest, and kept us updated from start to finish. His entire team did an outstanding job—they made sure to clean up thoroughly and even set our patio furniture back in place when they finished. We’ve worked with many pool service companies before, but this experience was by far the smoothest and most organized. What began as a simple pool cleaning became a full transformation! Everything happened just as promised, which is rare. We would highly recommend this pool cleaning crew to anyone in Denton looking for top-notch service!
reviews.author: Derek Bennett

reviews.text: If you need pool service in Denton, look no further. The team did an outstanding job replastering our pool and adding new tile. They made sure our pool met all the latest standards. Every crew member, especially Christopher, was friendly and easy to talk to, and they kept the area clean every day. It was a great experience having them work on our pool.
reviews.author: Leo Mathews

reviews.text: from the start of our pool project to the installation, chris and mike did a great job making sure everything went smoothly. they were always easy to reach and kept us updated about the schedule. the pool crew showed up on time and worked professionally every step of the way. even with all the work going on, they kept our yard in denton cleaner than we expected for a pool build. we really appreciate the care and attention they put into our new pool.
reviews.author: Frances Bradford

reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with how clean and sparkling our pool is thanks to blue science pools. even though it took a little while because of some material shortages, labor challenges, and weather, they stuck to their promise and gave us top notch pool cleaning service. the team always arrived on time, made sure to tidy up after themselves, and treated our backyard in denton with a lot of care. we were recommended to blue science pools by friends, and since we’ve had several pools cleaned before, we knew what to look for. austin, our pool technician, listened to what we needed and made sure everything was taken care of, from skimming the surface to vacuuming the pool floor and keeping our huge 67,000-gallon pool crystal clear. he even has a great sense of humor, which made the whole process more enjoyable. if you need pool cleaning in denton, we definitely suggest this company!
reviews.author: Sonia8 T

reviews.text: We moved into our home with a pool and decided to reach out to Blue Science Pools since they had installed it originally. We’ve been using their weekly pool maintenance service for several years now, and the experience has been fantastic. When our pool liner needed replacing, Eric was incredibly helpful throughout the whole process. He even guided us on how to find pool liner designs from the manufacturers that would help us save money. The weekly service is always dependable, and the team does an excellent job keeping the pool clean and clear—especially important during the hot summers in Denton. They always let me know about anything they notice or things I should keep an eye on with my pool equipment. It’s great being able to rely on a local company that really cares about their customers and the quality of their pool service.
reviews.author: King Baird

reviews.text: Chris from Blue Science Pools was the pool technician who came out to install my new pool heater in Denton. I was really glad he was assigned, since he was the one who found the problem with my old heater to begin with. In no time at all, he had the new heater set up, tested, and ready to go. The best part was how he took time to show me how to use the new unit and gave me some helpful tips for basic maintenance. Chris was professional, knew exactly what he was doing, and was also very friendly, which you don’t see every day. Overall, a great experience with my pool service.
reviews.author: M Tapia

reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Blue Science Pools! Mike and his team took over our pool project in Denton and got started right away. They showed up every day, answered our questions quickly, and worked efficiently. You can tell they care about their work and always put the customer first. We’ve started their weekly pool service now and couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend their team!
reviews.author: Rhonda Bush

reviews.text: we had such a great experience with our pool cleaning and replastering service in denton. chris and the team were very professional and made our old pool look amazing again. the decorative tile, which is decades old, looks sparkling clean and brand new after their work. highly recommend their pool cleaning services to anyone wanting their pool to shine!
reviews.author: Edgar Gordon

data.summary: The reviews present a highly suspicious pattern. The Google reviews are uniformly 5-star, lack authentic critical feedback, and read like curated testimonials. This starkly contrasts with the abysmal 1.4-star Yelp rating from 100 reviews, which strongly indicates significant customer service or quality issues. The extreme platform discrepancy is a major red flag for review authenticity on the positive side.
fake_signals: All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Google reviews use similar, generic positive language and project types
Lack of specific negative details or varied perspectives in Google sample
Extreme platform discrepancy suggests potential review manipulation on Google
authentic_signals: Google reviews mention specific employee names (Mike, Chris, Austin, Ardie, Blake, Eric, Christopher)
Google reviews mention specific locations (Denton) and some project details (replastering, retiling, heater installation)
complaint_patterns: Unclear from provided data, but low Yelp score indicates widespread dissatisfaction
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extreme discrepancy between Google (5.0) and Yelp (1.4). Google reviews are all 5-star with generic, positive language and lack critical details. Yelp rating is extremely low, suggesting a pattern of negative experiences not reflected on Google.
